1gnlfcy:267: The Agent Skills standard proposed by Anthropic fundamentally addresses a core problem with AI models: the lack of stable, reproducible execution workflows. Traditional prompt interaction follows a one-shot "instruction-response" pattern, where the AI has to understand the task context from scratch every time. Skills, by contrast, use a standardized directory structure (SKILL.md + scripts + reference docs + templates) to encapsulate procedural knowledge as components that AI can dynamically discover and load. This not only reduces the cognitive load on AI when executing tasks, but more importantly: Skills codify the best practices of the human developer community in a way that AI can understand and execute, enabling reuse of best practices across sessions and tasks.
